column3: comment  (voice line queue and sound listener / music helpers renamed by role; apply with RenameFns.java)
clears the queue tables at 0x8BE1E0 / 0x8BE7F0 / 0x8BD7BC / 0x8BE1F0 / 0x8BDCC0 (was weapon_ai_tables_clear)
(team 1..3, else 0): selects the queue count / queue entry tables of the team (g_weapon_8bed04 / 8bed08)
(index): clears one entry of the playing slot table at 0x8BE1E0
clears the four playing slot entries
returns index + 1 of a free playing slot and stores the line id + 1
voice_queue_select_tables for each team and clears its count
(player, line): points g_sound_8be7c0[player] at the record of the line, table chosen by the player's team
(line, team, player): adds a voice line to the team queue unless it is already queued / playing or the pair is on the same team (max 0x20 entries)
(line, team): removes a line from the team queue, shifting the following 0x28 byte entries
picks the next line of a queue and starts it (checks sound_allowed_for_pair, voice slot)
per player: counts frames (player_voice_counter_increment), updates its queue entries and voices
per frame entry: tick counter, race queue update (not for event types 0 and 1), player updates and pending lines
race phase dependent queue update (final lines, removals, resets)
queues the end of race lines (winner / last active player) depending on the race phase and game mode
starts the pending voice of the queue when the streams are idle (voice_set_two_params), then releases its slot
places the sound listener from the viewport camera matrix and position (validated with vec3_is_valid_small)
second fade variable stepped by -0.2 / +0.2 like sound_music_fade_step
music volume from option_get_volume_0 with the menu state (ui_fn_437ee0)
race phase 7: master fade to 0, music fade; course dependent music state
